en-US.description: Spec-first continuity framework for AI-assisted development
en-US.longDescription: Anchors ties spec, feature and test together through a shared identity code, then confronts each artifact against the rules declared in anchors.yaml. It maps the project as a graph, propagates change from the anchor outward, and gates every step — so work guided by AI stays anchored to what was decided.
en-US.name: Anchors
en-US.releaseNotes:
v0.1.389
- A gate's legacy can end: legacy.until. legacy: softens a gate for the targets last changed before a date, and until now it did so forever. until: <date> is its deadline: from that day on no target is legacy, and every one answers with the gate's own severity. Before it, a verdict the legacy softened says until when, and what it will do after. A new gate can now bar the new code at once and the old code from a date on, instead of leaving the old code pending without end. (GTENG-B37, CNFGO-B77, CNFGO-E13)
  - name: mutation-score
    blocking: true
    legacy:
      before: 2026-10-21
      until: 2026-12-15
      severity: {fail: inform}
  An until that is no date, or does not come after before, refuses the configuration.
This is the first item of DESIGN-proof-gaps.md, the plan built from the defects MIF traced to releases with every gate green; each item ships opt-in.
Everything in the v0.1.351 notes still applies: run anchors migrate once, crossing format 8.
Changelog
- 386c687 feat(gate): legacy.until — a gate's legacy ends on a deadline, and the old code answers as the new
